landmarks.name: the Central Vista lawns
landmarks.note: where the aircraft takes off, halfway along the avenue

landmarks.name: Kartavya Path
landmarks.note: the ceremonial avenue running east-west, 60 m clear between the two canals, with rows of jamun trees outside them

landmarks.name: India Gate
landmarks.note: a 42 m memorial arch standing alone on the lawns at the east end

landmarks.name: the north canal
landmarks.note: a long strip of water beside the avenue

landmarks.name: the south canal
landmarks.note: a long strip of water beside the avenue

landmarks.name: Vijay Chowk
landmarks.note: the open square at the foot of Raisina Hill, between the two Secretariat blocks -- clear of buildings, but the ground is already 14 m above the pad here

landmarks.name: Raisina Hill
landmarks.note: the ground rises 26 m from Vijay Chowk to the forecourt, so altitudes that clear the lawns do not clear this

landmarks.name: the North Block
landmarks.note: 42 m tall on ground already 24 m up: its roof is 66 m above the pad

landmarks.name: the South Block
landmarks.note: the mirror of the North Block, across Vijay Chowk

landmarks.name: Rashtrapati Bhavan
landmarks.note: the dome at the head of the vista, on the highest ground here

landmarks.name: Sansad Bhavan
landmarks.note: circular, 112 m across, north of the Secretariat
